name: Summer 2025 Riverine Flooding Event
location: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP), Western Punjab, Sindh (Kashmore, Ghotki, Sukkur, Shikarpur, Khairpur, Dadu, Naushero Feroz, Jamshoro, Larkana, Shaheed Benazirabad)
impact: Widespread inundation affecting 2.2 million people, 1,111 settlements, and critical infrastructure including 30 hospitals, 45 schools, and 780 km of roads. Peak flows reaching 500,000 cusecs at Sukkur Barrage.
context: A convergence of climatic factors including La Niña development, positive Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD), elevated Tibetan Plateau temperatures, and active Western Disturbances is causing severe flooding from 27th July to 3rd August 2025. Tarbela Dam is at maximum capacity, and localized cloud bursts are expected in the Kirthar Range.
